body: DESIGN CHECKPOINT — bd-01M15090X6JVTHM8ETWTF4T671, slice 1. Proposed contract before editing: (1) GeometryPair stores a typed GeometryPairRule supplied to validated, rather than silently inferring permitted asymmetry. The finite rules distinguish same view/instruction, view-only asymmetry, instruction-only asymmetry, and view+instruction asymmetry; role asymmetry remains mandatory Query→Document. (2) Hard compatibility always compares provider, dimension, normalization, truncation, and a full late-pooling compatibility key: presence, tokenizerFingerprint, contextLimit, window, stride, overlapMerge, pooling, uncovered, matryoshkaDimension. documentDigest is excluded because it identifies the embedded input, not the coordinate system; parent is derivation provenance and role-specific GeometryIds cannot share it. (3) No rule permits hard-key differences; the selected rule is stored in GeometryPair as receipt data. (4) ScalaCheck mutates each hard-key field and requires rejection, then checks that each view/instruction mismatch is rejected by rules that do not explicitly permit it and accepted only by the matching named rule. This preserves deliberate query/document modelling asymmetry without making it implicit. No privacy.scala/RemotePolicy changes in this slice. Chief: I will implement this unless you redirect the rule vocabulary.
